speaker: Lezard
original_jp: もう大丈夫でしょう今日はこの辺りで〓みませんか？
original_en:
I believe we are safe now.
Shall we adjourn here until the morrow?

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: なぜ大丈夫だと言える？
original_en: What makes you think we're safe?

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: 森に結界を張っておきました
original_en: I cast a force field around the forest.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: ウ〓ルザ様が〓送方陣で追ってきてもこの辺りには出られません
original_en:
Even were Walther to follow us by
teleportation, he would be unable to
reach us here.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: …それなら〓もうか
original_en: In that case, we should rest.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 私は構いません
original_en: I wouldn't mind resting.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: シルメリア殿かと思っていればいつの間に…
original_en:
You surprised me. I thought Silmeria was
still with us.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 普段は私が <PART> ――
original_en: Usually, it's just me...

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: 私はただ魔導師として 一つの肉体に二つの精神が宿る〓〓に感動しています
original_en:
As one versed in the arcane, I am merely
intrigued by two spirits sharing one body.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 適当に言い〓おうったってきっとシルメリアにはお見通しだぜ
original_en:
Sweet talk all you want. Silmeria can
see right through it.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: それぐらい できそうなもんだろ？
original_en: Well, seems like it should be possible.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: おもしろい 〓してみましょうか？
original_en: Interesting. Shall we give it a try?

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: これはこれは シルメリア殿 <PART> ――
original_en: It would be an honor, Lady Silmeria.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: 前世から離れられない強い思念があなたの中に残っているか <PART> ――
original_en:
If you have thoughts or feelings that
are inseparably bound to another life...

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: あなたに対して強く影〓を及ぼす他者の思念があれば 〓み取る事は可能よ
original_en:
...or memories of someone who affected
you deeply, then I can read those thoughts.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: そうですか…
original_en: Is that so?

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: …私は前世など知りたくない遠〓しておきましょう
original_en:
Allow me to abstain; I would rather not
know about my other lives.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: よろしければ お二方は？
original_en: Perhaps the gentlemen would oblige?

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: …俺は 前世もそのまた前世もディパンの〓臣だったと信じていたい
original_en:
I'd like to believe that in all my other
lives I have been a defender of Dipan.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 余計な事してると アーリィって奴に感づかれるんじゃないのかよ？
original_en:
If you mess around with your powers,
won't that other valkyrie detect us?

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: …確かにそうね
original_en: You've got a point.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: お二方も長旅でお疲れでしょう少し横になられてはいかがですか？
original_en:
You two must also be fatigued from your
journey. A brief respite is in order.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: 日が高くなる前に起こして差し上げますもちろん私は起きて番をしましょう
original_en:
I shall wake you before the sun is high.
Naturally, I shall keep watch as you rest.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: お許しください そのようなつもりで申し上げたのではありませんが…
original_en:
I beg your forgiveness; I never intended
to insinuate such a thing.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: …オブシェクトリーディングで人の心が〓めるという事ですか？
original_en:
So, can object reading be used to read
another's mind?

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 彼女が出てくるのはオブシェクトを見つけた時だけです
original_en:
She only comes out when we need her for
object reading.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: すみません 頼りにならなくて…
original_en:
I'm sorry. I wish I could be of more
help.
